record.question: According to DSM-5, what is the key characteristic of Anorexia Nervosa?
options: Excessive weight gain due to over eating then purging
Excessive food consumption then extreme exercising to lose weight
Restriction of food intake leading to significantly low body weight
Excessive restriction of certain food group
record.explanation: Answer C: Restriction of food intake leading to significantly low body weight. Anorexia nervosa includes restriction of energy intake leading to significantly low body weight, with associated fear of weight gain or behavior preventing weight gain and disturbance in body-image/self-evaluation. Reference: https://www.nimh.nih.gov/health/topics/eating-disorders. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
